about_the_game:
This is sheep Island. Home of conservatives, alcoholic politicians, serial killers, violent police and other citizens of the modern colonial civilization. From an early age you have longed to see the world, to become the master of your own life... To become an urban pirate. One day you quit your job. You set off to begin your new life in the western part of Sheep Island. All you have is 65 bucks, no job (with no intention of getting one) and a lust to live life dangerously...

You will roam the streets of Sheep Island, dodging police cars, eating shoplifted meals. You will travel to Shark City and challenge the established order with your streetwise charm and destructible lifestyle.

Unveil upgrades, skills, and many pieces of pirate equipment in order to match the increasing level of repression as you grow more free and fierce!

Become the urban pirate!

  • Shoplift as much as you can in 11 Levels and their bonus missions
  • Paint the trains, take over the streets!!
  • Skate the streets during the day, and dumpster dive during the night
  • Turn empty houses into your own space
  • Exchange your Street Credit and upgrade your pirate with new skills and equipment
  • Become an urban legend and unlock all the achievements
  • Original 8-bit soundtrack

Created by Baby Duka
Sound by B. Magic Samples

content_descriptors.notes:
"Urban Pirate" is a visual story that, with self-irony, portrays the tragicomic life of a young, anti-authoritarian rebel in a Western city during the 2000s. The main character must steal from supermarkets, scavenge through dumpsters, smoke marijuana, skateboard, live in an abandoned house with his squatter friends, throw Molotov cocktails at police forces, and struggle against the local authorities just to get through everyday life.

Although the story is humorous and self-ironic, this may be difficult for younger audiences to understand. The game is not recommended for younger players or for those who wish to avoid themes of crime, drugs, tobacco, or questionable morals.

There are one or two brief animations in which the main character is attacked by a gang member, and in a few scenes, he is pinned to the ground during an arrest. When the character falls off his skateboard, a minor nosebleed may also occur.

reviews:
“There are raves to attend, skateboarding skills to master, buildings to squat in, and trains to graffiti. Who knew that being a criminal could be so time-consuming?”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“Lets players give in to their inner delinquent, having them shoplift, spraypaint, skateboard, and squat in abandoned buildings as they steadily overtake the streets of Sheep Island.”
Siliconera

“Going for a very unique visual style and a chill background of jazzy chiptune, Urban Pirate truly looks like a breath of fresh air on the indie scene”
TechRaptor
short_description: The original petty crime simulator. A flammable mix of turn-based survival and action-packed mini-games.
